findings.title: Security Advisory: Pre-authentication stack buffer overflow in D-Link DIR-600L authentication.cgi (draft)
findings.summary_md: Draft advisory uploaded on 2026-10-21 describing a pre-authentication stack buffer overflow (CWE-121) in authentication.cgi on D-Link DIR-600L hardware revision B, firmware 2.17b02, image DIR-600Bx_FW217b02.bin with MD5 2f953ec274caeab6bc643045da56ab29, reproduced in a qemu-mipsel re-hosted CGI environment. Its strace_authentication_cgi.log capture shows the forked login CGI child crashing with SIGSEGV at attacker-influenced fault address 0x47474747 after an unauthenticated request with an overlong id or password parameter, while the parent HTTP daemon kept serving. The advisory marks itself a draft with no CVE assigned or confirmed and states the evidence does not establish instruction-pointer control, system-wide code execution, or persistence.

findings.title: CVE Record: CVE-2026-129353 (VulDB)
findings.summary_md: VulDB assigned and published CVE-2026-129353 on 2026-11-14 for a stack-based buffer overflow in authenticationcgi_main of authentication.cgi in D-Link DIR-600L firmware 2.17 and 2.17b02, triggered by manipulation of the id and password arguments, with CVSS 10.0 scored across CVSS 2.0, 3.0, 3.1, and 4.0 and exploit maturity marked POC. The record credits reporter ruanyi (VulDB User), references VulDB submit 1043523 and the GitHub draft advisory, and leaves the fixed version empty. The CVE was reserved at 06:37:47 UTC and published at 23:15:19 UTC the same day.

findings.title: CVE-2026-129353: DIR-600L Stack-based Buffer Overflow, OffSeq Threat Radar
findings.summary_md: OffSeq Threat Radar published this record at 2026-11-14T23:15:19Z and modified it at 23:23:35Z, flagging the flaw Public exploit available at CVSS 10.0 Critical while labeling the score Thin evidence from one scorer or none. Its exploitation evidence section records the CVE as disclosed on 14 Nov 2026 and weaponized via a public proof of concept, with no exploitation in the wild, no public nuclei template indexed, no CISA KEV listing, and no attack traffic seen by OffSeq Mirage sensors. Affected firmware is listed as 2.17 and 2.17b02 with no fixed version, and the guidance is to disable remote access to the authentication interface or isolate the device until a fix is available.
